title: How to pray
intro: Prayer is a conversation with God, who already knows us and loves us. Jesus teaches us to pray simply and sincerely, to trust the Father, and to persevere. The Church prays with Scripture, especially the Our Father, and every prayer can begin with just a few honest words.
phrasings: what is the right way to pray
how can I talk to God
how should I pray every day
I don't know how to pray
what does the Bible say about prayer
how to start a prayer life

verses.why: Jesus gives the Our Father as the model of all prayer.
Pray sincerely, not to be seen, and without empty repetition.
Ask, seek, and knock; God answers those who persevere.
The Spirit helps us when we do not know what to say.
Pray continually and give thanks in all circumstances.

title: Forgiveness
intro: God's mercy has no limit, and he asks us to share it. We are forgiven so that we can forgive, even when it is hard. Forgiving does not excuse the wrong; it releases us from bitterness and entrusts justice to God. Catholics receive God's forgiveness of sins in the Sacrament of Reconciliation.
phrasings: I can't forgive the person who hurt me
what does the Bible say about forgiveness
how many times should I forgive
how to let go of anger and resentment

verses.why: Forgive not seven times but seventy-seven times.
Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
If we confess our sins, God is faithful to forgive.
God removes our sins as far as east is from west.
Jesus forgives even those who crucify him.

title: Anxiety and worry
intro: Scripture speaks tenderly to anxious hearts. God does not ask us to pretend we are not afraid; he invites us to hand him our worries and trust that he cares. Bring each concern to him in prayer, take today one step at a time, and receive his peace.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about anxiety
how to find peace when I am stressed

verses.why: Bring everything to God in prayer and his peace will guard your heart.
Cast all your worries on him because he cares for you.
Do not worry about tomorrow; your Father knows what you need.
God promises to be with you and to uphold you.
Christ gives a peace that the world cannot give.

title: How to be saved
intro: Salvation is a gift of God's grace through Jesus Christ, received in faith. Catholics understand it as a living relationship: we are saved by grace, we respond with faith working through love, and we are sustained by the sacraments, beginning with Baptism. It is not earned, but it is meant to be lived.
phrasings: what must I do to be saved
how do I get to heaven
what does the Bible say about salvation

verses.why: We are saved by grace through faith, created for good works.
Believe in the Lord Jesus and you will be saved.
God sent his Son so that the world might be saved through him.
Confess Jesus as Lord and believe in your heart.
Work out your salvation with reverence; God is at work in you.

title: Why does God allow suffering?
intro: The Bible does not give a simple explanation for suffering, but it gives something better: God does not stand far away. In Jesus he enters our pain, and Scripture shows suffering being used for growth, compassion and hope, never wasted. Evil is not God's will, and he promises to wipe away every tear.
phrasings: why do bad things happen to good people
why is there evil in the world
why did God let this happen
where is God when I suffer
what does the Bible say about suffering
how to find meaning in pain

verses.why: Present sufferings cannot compare with the glory to come.
God works all things for good for those who love him.
God comforts us so we can comfort others.
Job meets God in the midst of unexplained suffering.
God will wipe away every tear and there will be no more pain.

title: Heaven and life after death
intro: Scripture promises that death is not the end. For those who belong to Christ, heaven is life with God, face to face, with every tear wiped away, and the Church also hopes for the resurrection of the body. Jesus has gone ahead to prepare a place for us.
phrasings: will I see my loved ones in heaven
what does the Bible say about heaven
how do I get into heaven

verses.why: Jesus prepares a place for us and will take us to himself.
No eye has seen what God has prepared for those who love him.
God dwells with his people and there is no more death.
We will be changed, and death is swallowed up in victory.
Jesus promises the repentant thief: today you will be with me in paradise.

title: Hell and judgment
intro: Scripture warns seriously about the possibility of final separation from God, which is the Church's meaning of hell. It is the result of freely and finally rejecting his love, never God's desire. He wants all to be saved, so the warnings are a call to conversion while there is time.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about hell
does a loving God send people to hell

verses.why: Christ describes the final judgment, based on love shown to the least.
God is patient, wanting all to come to repentance.
God desires all people to be saved.
A sober warning to turn from whatever leads us to sin.
God takes no pleasure in the death of the wicked but wants them to turn and live.

title: Divorce and remarriage
intro: Jesus teaches that marriage is a lifelong covenant, rooted in creation itself. The Catholic Church holds that a valid marriage cannot be dissolved, while recognizing that annulments, separations and wounded hearts are real, and that those who are divorced remain loved members of the Church. Anyone in this situation is encouraged to speak with a priest.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about divorce
I am divorced can I receive communion
how to save my marriage from divorce

verses.why: Jesus answers the question on divorce by returning to God's original plan.
What God has joined together, let no one separate.
God cares deeply about faithfulness in marriage.
Paul addresses separation and mixed marriages.
The Lord is close to the brokenhearted.

title: What is sin?
intro: Sin is a free choice that turns away from God's love and wounds ourselves and others. The Bible is honest about sin, but never leaves it there: the same Scripture that names sin proclaims a Savior who forgives. The Church distinguishes mortal from venial sin, and offers Confession as the path back.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about sin
what is the difference between mortal and venial sin

verses.why: All have sinned and fall short of God's glory.
John distinguishes sin that leads to death from sin that does not.
Paul shows the struggle between what we want and what we do.
A model prayer of a sinner asking for mercy.
The wages of sin is death, but God's gift is eternal life.

title: Who is Jesus?
intro: The Gospels present Jesus as the Son of God made man: the Word through whom all things were made, who lived among us, died for our sins and rose again. He is fully God and fully human, our Lord, our Savior and our friend.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about Jesus
who is the Son of God

verses.why: The Word was God and became flesh.
Peter confesses Jesus as the Christ, the Son of the living God.
Jesus is the way, the truth and the life.
In Christ all things were created and reconciled.
The earliest proclamation of his death and resurrection.

title: Love
intro: Love is at the heart of the whole Bible. God is love, and he commands us to love him and our neighbor. Biblical love is patient, selfless and willing to sacrifice, and it is first of all a gift we receive before it is something we give.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about love

verses.why: Paul's famous description of what love is and is not.
God is love, and we love because he first loved us.
Love of God and neighbor sums up the whole law.
There is no greater love than to lay down one's life for friends.
God proved his love by Christ dying for us while we were still sinners.

title: Faith and works
intro: Scripture teaches both that we are saved by grace through faith and that faith without works is dead. The Catholic understanding holds these together: good works do not earn salvation, but they are the living expression of the faith that saves.
phrasings: are we saved by faith or works
do good deeds get me to heaven
what does the Bible say about works
do I have to do good works to be saved

verses.why: Faith without works is dead.
Saved by grace through faith, created for good works.
What matters is faith working through love.
A person is justified by faith apart from works of the law.
Christ judges by how we served the least of his brothers.

title: The Trinity
intro: The Trinity is the central mystery of the Christian faith: one God in three Persons, Father, Son and Holy Spirit. The word is not in the Bible, but the truth is revealed throughout it, most clearly at Jesus' baptism and in his command to baptize in the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.
phrasings: is the Trinity in the Bible
are Father Son and Holy Spirit one God
what does the Bible say about the Holy Spirit

verses.why: Baptize in the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.
At Jesus' baptism, Father, Son and Spirit are revealed together.
Jesus promises the Father will send another Advocate, the Spirit.
A Trinitarian blessing of grace, love and fellowship.
The Lord our God is one.

title: The purpose of life
intro: According to Scripture, we were made by God and for God. Our purpose is to know him, love him and serve him in this life, and to be happy with him forever. Each person also has a particular calling, a way of loving and serving that only they can give.
phrasings: what is my purpose in life
what is the meaning of life
what does God want from me
how to find God's plan for my life

verses.why: God has plans for your welfare and a future of hope.
We are God's handiwork, created for good works prepared for us.
Fear God and keep his commandments; this is the whole duty of man.
Trust in the Lord and he will make your paths straight.
Act justly, love mercy and walk humbly with God.

title: Fear and courage
intro: "Do not be afraid" is one of the most repeated phrases in Scripture. God does not promise a life without frightening moments; he promises his presence in them. Courage in the Bible is not the absence of fear but trusting God while afraid.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about fear

verses.why: Do not fear, for I am with you.
Be strong and courageous; the Lord is with you wherever you go.
Even in the darkest valley, I fear no evil for you are with me.
God gave us a spirit of power, love and self-discipline.
The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?

title: Loneliness
intro: Loneliness is deeply human, and the Bible is full of people who felt alone. The promise of Scripture is that God never leaves us, and that he places us in a family, the Church, so that we do not have to carry life by ourselves.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about loneliness

verses.why: The Lord goes before you and will never leave you.
A prayer of a lonely and afflicted soul.
Jesus is with us always, to the end of the age.
God sets the lonely in families.
God says: I will never leave you nor forsake you.

title: Depression and hopelessness
intro: Scripture does not hide dark seasons; the psalms and the prophets cry out in despair and are heard. If you are struggling, you are not weak and you are not alone. God is close to the brokenhearted. Please also reach out to someone you trust, a priest, a counselor or a doctor, and if you are in danger, contact emergency services or a crisis line right away.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about depression
I don't want to go on
I am so tired of everything and feel numb

verses.why: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted.
Why are you downcast, my soul? Put your hope in God.
God lifts us out of the pit.
His mercies are new every morning.
May the God of hope fill you with joy and peace.

title: Money, tithing and wealth
intro: The Bible does not condemn money itself but warns against the love of it and calls us to generosity, especially toward the poor. Everything we have is a gift from God to be used wisely. Giving, tithing and almsgiving are practices that keep our hearts free.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about money
is it a sin to be rich
how should I use my money
what does the Bible say about wealth
can you serve God and money

verses.why: Store up treasure in heaven, for your heart follows your treasure.
You cannot serve both God and money.
The love of money is a root of all kinds of evil.
God loves a cheerful giver.
Bring the tithes into the storehouse.

title: Grief and the death of a loved one
intro: Jesus himself wept at the tomb of his friend. Grief is the price of love, and God does not rush us through it. The Christian hope is that death does not have the last word, and the Church prays for the dead and trusts them to God's mercy.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about death
how to deal with losing someone

verses.why: Jesus weeps with those who grieve.
Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
We do not grieve as those without hope.
Jesus is the resurrection and the life.
The Church has long prayed for the dead.

title: Baptism
intro: Baptism is the first sacrament, by which we are cleansed of sin, born again as God's children and welcomed into the Church. Jesus himself was baptized and commanded his disciples to baptize all nations. The New Testament also shows whole households being baptized.
phrasings: what does the Bible say about baptism
what is the meaning of baptism

verses.why: Unless one is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom.
Jesus commands baptism in the name of the Trinity.
Be baptized for the forgiveness of sins; the promise is for you and your children.
In baptism we are buried and raised with Christ.
The jailer and his whole household were baptized.
